about.en: NEX is the native token of Nexus, a layer-1 blockchain from Nexus Labs and the Nexus Foundation built for exchange infrastructure and verifiable computation, which hosts the Nexus Exchange order-book spot and perpetuals venue and builds on the team's Nexus zkVM. It trades as an ERC-20 token on Ethereum (contract 0xf57D49646621F563b0B905aFc8336923AC569Ec5) with a supply of 100 trillion tokens, which is why its unit price is a fraction of a cent.
